Jo: Quick ask — MicroSeq mini-benchmark launch + webinar (live Apr 10). Need a slim creative bundle for web, ads, and slides. Can design confirm scope and rough ETA?

Rina: Yep. What outputs do you need?

Jo: Essentials only: 1920x1080 hero (PNG + 6s MP4 loop), 1280x720 low-bandwidth hero, social tiles (1200x1200 & 1200x628), SVG sparkline + PNG fallback, single-page PDF one-pager, Google Slides master, and Figma component tokens. Text layers must be editable for en/es.

Marco: Timing: initial comps in 48h, final pack in 5 days if copy/headshots arrive tomorrow. Any legal constraints?

Anya: Use tempered language — "optimized for low-latency inference" not "fastest". If you want a numeric claim, send methodology and numbers for sign-off. Use --redwood-500 for accents and ensure AA contrast.

Jo: Copy team will push final microcopy + headshots by EOD tomorrow. Marco, please include an assets manifest and naming convention for dev.

Marco: Will export manifest and a small README. Example filenames: microseq_hero_1920x1080_v1.png, microseq_hero_1920x1080_loop_v1.mp4, microseq_sparkline_v1.svg, microseq_social_1200x1200_v1@2x.png, microseq_onepager_v1.pdf, microseq_slidemaster_v1.gslides.

DesignBot: Automated exports queued; will attach manifest URL in Figma when ready.

Jo: Great — confirm initial comps in 48h and final by Apr 5. Ping here if anything blocks. :rocket:
